title: Sources: OpenAI has secured ~$11B in commitments for its latest funding round, less than half its initial $30B target, and expects to raise more in coming weeks (Berber Jin/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Berber Jin / Wall Street Journal: Sources: OpenAI has secured ~$11B in commitments for its latest funding round, less than half its initial $30B target, and expects to raise more in coming weeks — The ChatGPT maker's latest funding round values it at $1.25 trillion, less than its $1.4 trillion target
